content.value: Design an interior panel (panel B) for a flat plate floor system as shown in the following figure. Assume a service live load equal to 88psf, a service dead load equal to114 psf (including self-weight), fy = 60,000 psi, fc'= 3000 psi, normal-weight concrete, and column heights of 12 ft. Given that percentage of interior negative design moments to be resisted by middle strip is 25% and percentages of positive design moment to be resisted by column strip is 60%.Show the reinforcement detailing for long direction only.
